quest.title: Witch's Chatter
quest.description: After completing the mage's lodge, the sounds of laughter and cheer can be heard coming from within...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: My oh my, the final product has exceeded all my expectations... If anyone actually does stumble in here by mistake, I'm sure they will be truly awe-inspired by this mage's might.

choices.text: If someone really does end up here by accident...

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Well, that all depends on the sort of person they are.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Guidance can encourage complacency and entitlement if you're not careful. If someone is eager to rely on their own abilities, like you do, then I'll gladly help them.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: But if they're the type of person who pins all their hopes on the mage's power, while doing none of the work themselves... Hehe.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...W—Would you really turn them into a statue?

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: No, nothing like that. But I would guide them out of this place to the nearby Curatorium of Secrets. I'm sure Nefer would know how to deal with them much better than I do.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Those who seek to reap without sowing ought to pay the price, don't you think?

choices.text: Will you guide them to fulfill their wishes?
